what: Time for one 9-way structured-output routing decision, per candidate Gemini model.
why: The merged copilot pays a router LLM call on every turn, so this number is spent once per question. PLAN.md budgets 2.0s for the whole turn including STT and speech synthesis.
question: how wide does a trace need to be for 3 amps on 1oz external copper
prompt: router.py ROUTER_PROMPT, 9 routes, Pydantic RouteDecision via with_structured_output
caveats: Single sample per model, cold. The 25s for gemini-3.1-flash-lite may be cold-start rather than steady-state.
Measured off-Pi. The Pi adds nothing to this number itself (it is a network round trip) but its STT and TTS legs are what the 2.0s budget is mostly spent on.
gemini-2.5-flash and gemini-2.5-flash-lite returned 404 for this key and are not in the table.
